NOT FOUND.

What I searched:
- Queried the indexed "docs" corpus with ow_query for:
  - "passport" (verdict: absent)
  - "passport renewal application submitted" (verdict: low_confidence; returned unrelated "renewal" fragments)
- Searched the documents folder contents and text:
  - Listed directories: letters/, receipts/, insurance/, medical/, statements/, tax/
  - Inspected letters/ (letter-001.docx ... letter-052.docx, oakridge-renewal-2024.docx)
  - Inspected receipts/ (receipt-002.pdf ... receipt-053.pdf, brightline-dental-2024-03.pdf)
  - Inspected insurance/ (car-policy-2024.pdf, home-policy-2024.pdf)
  - Ran grep for "passport" (case-insensitive) across letters/, receipts/, insurance/ and the whole docs folder — no matches
  - Ran grep across docs for "renewal application|passport renewal|passport application|application submitted|submitted" — no matches

Because none of the indexed documents or files contain the submission date for a passport renewal application, I cannot provide it.
